flag.name: Flag of Alaska
flag.description: Eight gold stars, in the shape of the Big Dipper on a dark blue field. The North Star is larger than the other 7.
flag.symbolism: Navy represents the evening sky, sea, mountain lakes, and wild flowers. Gold represents the wealth of the land of Alaska. Ursa Major, the Great Bear, is the most conspicuous constellation in the northern sky. The North Star is a constant waypoint for Alaska's outdoorsmen and represents Alaska itself as the northernmost state.

seal.name: Seal of the State of Alaska
seal.description: At top, rays of the northern lights above mountains. Below, a smelter representing mining, a train representing railroads, and ships representing transportation by sea. At bottom, trees representing timber, and a farmer with horse and three shocks of wheat representing agriculture. Along the perimeter, a fish and seal representing fishing and seal rookeries.

symbols.quarter: State quarter featuring grizzly bear with salmon and North Star. Caption: "The Great Land."
